description: Call this when the user wants a free resource to start with or to brief their leadership. Describes the free AI Capability Briefing Kit (a 10-page PDF) and how to get it. Does not deliver the file; if the user asks to receive it by email, use email_me_the_kit. For a readiness check, use assess_ai_readiness.
name: get_starter_kit
